overall: GOOD this afternoon, breezy tonight on the east-facing grounds
limiterDetail: The main limiter is a combination: current at Barangonan, Tara and Turda (0.8–1.2 kt this afternoon into early Tuesday) and wind tonight at Ciron, Cabunlawan, Decabaitot and Nangalao (13–17 kt from about 6–7 PM, staying 13–15 kt through Tuesday). Rain is a minor factor: light showers about 3–8 AM Tuesday (up to 0.7 mm/h at Barangonan, Cabunlawan and Decabaitot).

pagasa.detail: PAGASA: CLEAR. No gale, wind signal or heavy-rain warning for Calamian / MIMAROPA (latest entries are Davao Region gale advisories, last one marked final on 31 Oct). The feed still lists a tropical cyclone alert for Typhoon Rosal (Champi) that doesn't name Palawan; worth a glance on the PAGASA site.

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since this morning
items: The soft day moved from Thursday to Wednesday. Tuesday is now breezier and a bit wetter (9.3 kt, gusts 14, 3.4 mm; this morning it was 6.8 kt, gusts 12, 2.2 mm), and the east wind at Cabunlawan, Decabaitot, Ciron and Nangalao now holds at 13–15 kt through Tuesday daytime instead of easing. So Wed 4 supply is now SLIGHTLY SOFT (was near normal).

Wednesday is a little gentler than forecast (10 kt, gusts 16, dry), so Thu 5 improves to NEAR NORMAL (was slightly soft). Saturday is now the breeziest day of the week (11 kt, gusts 18), so Sun 8 slips to SLIGHTLY SOFT (was near normal). Today stays SLIGHTLY SOFT and Tue 3 stays NORMAL. Grounds now read 13 GOOD / 2 MARGINAL / 1 POOR / 0 VERY POOR (6 AM: 13 GOOD / 3 MARGINAL / 0 POOR). PAGASA shows no warning for Palawan.

shortageRisk: Surge flag OFF (unchanged). The dashboard's shortage detector stays ELEVATED for Tue–Sun (guide only; it reacts to the 0.4–0.6 kt daily currents). Tightening risk is light: soft patches today, Wednesday and Sunday only. Plan bigger buys on Tuesday's landings, and this afternoon lean on Panlaitan, Maglalambay, Alava, Binudac and the Coron side.

details: Panlaitan and Maglalambay: 1–4 kt until about 5 PM, current 0.1–0.3 kt (again 4–7 kt Tuesday 7 AM–1 PM). Alava and Binudac: 3–5 kt to 5 PM, current 0.3–0.5.
